name: Binary Greedy Voxel Meshing with Ambient Occlusion
definition: A variant of voxel meshing that calculates ambient occlusion values for each vertex based on the solidity of surrounding voxels, stored in the vertex data.
summary: Binary Greedy Voxel Meshing with Ambient Occlusion generates blocky meshes from voxel data while baking per-vertex ambient occlusion values based on surrounding voxel solidity, distinguishing it from methods that output uniform occlusion.
